declaration_basis: Both published national pages declare app.js; its House and Senate components explicitly fetch these two national JSON inventories.
date_qualification: Election date is reviewed index context, not a native per-race date field. Count clocks are native updated epoch milliseconds, never retrieval times.
party_rule: Exact native Dem=D and GOP=R. All other literal labels, aggregate Other and unknown counts remain distinct.
nonvoting_house_seats: Kept separately if advertised; never counted among the 435 voting districts.
senate_baseline_rule: Only the delivered explicitly reviewed 2020 regular-seat-cycle FEC comparison binds Class II. Special/unexpired, intervening-special and unmatched stages remain held.
